request.style: English, solo male folk voice, acoustic guitar, soft fiddle, gentle percussion, warm and narrative, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
From the tribe of Zebulun stood a man
Gaddiel son of Sodi was his name
Moses sent him from the Wilderness of Paran
To scout the land as the Lord did command

[Verse]
He walked through the Negev up to Hebron
Saw the giants there, the strong and the seven
They cut a cluster in the Valley of Eshcol
And carried it on a pole for the whole

[Chorus]
Forty days they wandered out
And came back to show the fruit
The land flows with milk and honey
But the people are too strong to suit

[Verse]
They reported to the congregation
In Kadesh by the wilderness land
Caleb spoke to quiet the fear
But others said we cannot stand

[Chorus]
Forty days they wandered out
And came back to show the fruit
The land flows with milk and honey
But the people are too strong to suit

[Bridge]
We seemed like grasshoppers in their eyes
Devoured by the land we spied
The congregation wept through the night
Grumbling loud against their guide

[Outro]
Back to Egypt they wished to go
Leaving the promise to break
